AcknowledgeAlertRequest.description: Which alert a human has seen; the key is the worker's ``group:subject``.
AcknowledgeAlertRequest.title: AcknowledgeAlertRequest

AlertGroup.description: Open alerts for one metric group (runtime, data quality, feature drift).
AlertGroup.title: AlertGroup

ClassProbabilityDrift.description: One class's probability distribution scored against its training baseline.
ClassProbabilityDrift.title: ClassProbabilityDrift

ClassShift.description: How far one predicted class moved from its reference share.
ClassShift.title: ClassShift

ConfidenceBlock.description: How sure the classifier is, against how sure it was on its training data.
ConfidenceBlock.title: ConfidenceBlock

DeploymentInfo.description:
One row of the deployment listing — enough for a machine client to iterate.

The monitoring fields are additive: the listing that always answered "what runs
here" now also answers "what is monitored here", so a client with an API key can
discover deployments without first consulting the Platform.
DeploymentInfo.title: DeploymentInfo

FeatureDriftDetail.description: Per-selected-feature drift detail: the reference-vs-current shape and PSI over time.
FeatureDriftDetail.title: FeatureDriftDetail

HorizonDrift.description: One forecast horizon scored against its training baseline.
HorizonDrift.title: HorizonDrift

InvalidValueSummary.description:
What was wrong with the values a feature's rates counted.

The rates say how broken the input is; this says broken how — which categories arrived
unseen, how far past the reference bounds the numbers went, what types came instead.
InvalidValueSummary.title: InvalidValueSummary

MetricIncident.description: One stretch during which a metric was failing.
MetricIncident.title: MetricIncident

NearThreshold.description: How often binary predictions sit in the decision boundary's coin-flip zone.
NearThreshold.title: NearThreshold

OutputDriftResponse.description:
Did the model's outputs shift against the reference output distribution?

The snapshot half (psi, distribution) reads the latest materialized window; the
series are assembled from the window history of the selected time range.
OutputDriftResponse.title: OutputDriftResponse

ProbabilityBlock.description: Per-class probability drift, from the full vectors the artifact reports.
ProbabilityBlock.title: ProbabilityBlock

RuntimeBaseline.description: The comparison period's rollup, so every runtime card can show its delta.
RuntimeBaseline.title: RuntimeBaseline

SectionState.description: Per-section data state, so one GreptimeDB blip degrades a section, not the dashboard.
SectionState.title: SectionState

StatusBreakdownRow.description:
How the window's calls ended, one row per outcome and HTTP code.

The counters above say how many calls failed; this says how they failed, which is what
separates a saturated model server (504) from a caller sending bad payloads (422).
StatusBreakdownRow.title: StatusBreakdownRow

TraceDetail.description:
One inference call, opened from the traces table.

Unlike :class:`TraceRow`, `inputs` and `output` are the full payloads (decoded
from their stored JSON when possible), not the truncated table-cell summaries.
TraceDetail.title: TraceDetail

TraceRow.description: One recent inference call. Local-only: served only into the same-origin iframe.
TraceRow.title: TraceRow

TraceSpan.description:
One span of an inference trace.

Field-for-field the span shape the Platform's experiment-snapshot viewer renders,
so the Satellite dashboard can reuse the same tree + waterfall + details screen.
The tree is built client-side from `parent_span_id`, exactly as the Platform does.
TraceSpan.title: TraceSpan

WorkerHealthResponse.description: Whether the background worker is keeping up for this deployment.
WorkerHealthResponse.title: WorkerHealthResponse
